answer: Think of honest agents as settlements scattered across a frozen tundra: each must post a renewable bond to stay active. Spinning up a Sybil clone needs a fresh bond per identity, so a thousand fakes cost a thousand deposits, not one. Attestation accuracy is scored like grading saffron strand by strand, costly and hard to fake, and dishonest countersignatures slash the bond. Earned reputation becomes a rare oasis you grow slowly over epochs and can never simply copy.
